adaptation_problem: Sequential regression under delayed labels, distractor shift, a conflicting regime, a returning regime, and a novel regime.

prediction_receives: state produced only from labels whose availability time has arrived
information_timing.label_rule: A target may affect state only at or after label_available_at, always after its prediction.

candidate_falsifiers.learned_rule: Under an owner-approved successor protocol, reject the learned mechanism if its held-out external prequential MSE fails to improve over the development-selected standard optimizer under total cost accounting, or if gradient, stability, horizon-transfer, parameter-scale, or checkpoint gates fail.
candidate_falsifiers.memory_weight: Under an owner-approved successor protocol, reject the memory-weight mechanism if its held-out external prequential MSE fails to improve over information- and resource-matched cache, replay, and ordinary-update baselines, or if delayed-label, capacity, reset, or accounting gates fail.

protected_evaluation.admission_requirement: A dated local owner decision selecting exactly one candidate line and a separately versioned protocol successor.
